sources: Sources: Al Jazeera, Associated Press, Reuters, The Wall Street Journal, The Times, CNN, NBC News, Agence France-Presse — 21 Nov 2026. Figures as reported on the day; casualty counts may be revised.

stories.headline: AI Sell-Off Triggers Global Market Correction
stories.summary: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq entered correction territory as Nvidia fell about 14% and the Nikkei dropped 5.1%.

stories.headline: El Chapo Isidro Captured in Sinaloa
stories.summary: Mexican special forces captured FBI Most Wanted fugitive Fausto Isidro Meza Flores and two other cartel leaders in Guasave.

stories.headline: Kryvyi Rih Under Fire
stories.summary: Russian missiles killed two and wounded 60, including six children, in President Zelenskyy's hometown.

stories.headline: Antalya Talks Fail to Meet Deadline
stories.summary: Nearly 200 countries are deadlocked over fossil fuel mentions and a $120bn-a-year adaptation finance target.

stories.headline: Projectiles Strike Hormuz Oil Tankers
stories.summary: Two tankers were hit near Khasab, and Iran's Revolutionary Guard claims it shot down a US MQ-9 drone.

stories.headline: Pancreatic Cancer Trial Success
stories.summary: Daraxonrasib made tumours undetectable in 1 in 12 patients during a 61-person phase 1/2 trial.
